_notice: FICTITIOUS. Case status codes for a support program that does not exist.
usage: Every status field in a QuorvantaConnect case record holds one of these codes. patient_text is the approved wording an assistant uses to report the status (it fills {{bv.status_text}} and similar placeholders in ps-responses.json); it may itself contain placeholders from the case record. meaning is internal and is not read to patients. No patient_text predicts a plan's or the Foundation's decision.

statuses.meaning: Enrollment complete; plan not yet contacted or not yet responded.
statuses.patient_text: We're checking your coverage with your plan now. This usually takes about 1 business day, and we'll send you a summary when it's done.

statuses.meaning: Insurance details missing or rejected by the plan.
statuses.patient_text: We need a bit more information about your insurance before we can check your coverage. A photo of the front and back of your insurance card is usually enough; you can send it at quorvantaconnect.example.

statuses.meaning: Plan reports QUORVANTA covered without prior authorization.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan told us on {{bv.completed_on}} that it covers QUORVANTA and doesn't need a prior authorization. Your plan makes the final decision on coverage.

statuses.meaning: Plan reports QUORVANTA covered subject to prior authorization.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan told us on {{bv.completed_on}} that it needs a prior authorization before it will cover QUORVANTA. We're working on that with your healthcare provider's office.

statuses.meaning: Plan reports QUORVANTA excluded or not on formulary.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan told us on {{bv.completed_on}} that QUORVANTA isn't on its list of covered drugs. Your healthcare provider can ask the plan for an exception, and your case manager can explain the options.

statuses.meaning: Plan mandates a specialty pharmacy that is not in the QUORVANTA network.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan requires a pharmacy that can't supply QUORVANTA, so we've asked your plan to allow a network pharmacy instead. We'll let you know when the plan decides.

statuses.meaning: No prior authorization needed.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan doesn't need a prior authorization for QUORVANTA.

statuses.meaning: PA prepared; waiting for prescriber office signature or clinical notes.
statuses.patient_text: We've prepared the prior authorization and are waiting for your healthcare provider's office to sign it. You're welcome to remind them, but you don't need to do anything else.

statuses.meaning: PA sent to plan; no decision yet.
statuses.patient_text: We sent the prior authorization to your plan on {{pa.submitted_on}}. We'll let you and your healthcare provider's office know when the plan decides.

statuses.meaning: Plan approved PA.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan approved the prior authorization on {{pa.decided_on}}. Your specialty pharmacy will call you to schedule your delivery.

statuses.meaning: Plan denied PA; no appeal filed yet.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan said no to the prior authorization on {{pa.decided_on}}. The reason it gave was: {{pa.denial_reason}}. We've sent your healthcare provider's office what they need if they decide to appeal.

statuses.meaning: Appeal filed; no decision yet.
statuses.patient_text: An appeal was sent to your plan on {{pa.appeal_submitted_on}}. We'll let you and your healthcare provider's office know when the plan decides.

statuses.meaning: Plan reversed denial on appeal.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan approved QUORVANTA on appeal on {{pa.decided_on}}. Your specialty pharmacy will call you to schedule your delivery.

statuses.meaning: All plan appeal levels exhausted and denied.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan has made a final decision not to cover QUORVANTA. Your case manager will talk with you about whether you may qualify for the Arden Quay Patient Assistance Foundation.

statuses.meaning: Asked plan to allow a network pharmacy in place of its mandated non-network pharmacy.
statuses.patient_text: We've asked your plan to let a network pharmacy fill your prescription. We'll let you know when the plan decides.

statuses.meaning: Plan allowed a network pharmacy.
statuses.patient_text: Your plan has agreed to let a network pharmacy fill your prescription. That pharmacy will call you to schedule your delivery.

statuses.meaning: Patient has not enrolled in the copay program.
statuses.patient_text: You're not enrolled in the copay program.

statuses.meaning: Enrolled and eligible; annual maximum not reached.
statuses.patient_text: Your copay program enrollment is active.

statuses.meaning: Annual maximum reached this calendar year.
statuses.patient_text: The copay program has paid its $16,000 limit for this year, so you'll pay what your plan charges until the limit starts over on January 1.

statuses.meaning: Not eligible because enrolled in a government program.
statuses.patient_text: The copay program isn't available because your insurance includes a government health program.

statuses.meaning: Benefits ended on the date the patient became ineligible.
statuses.patient_text: Your copay program benefits ended on {{copay.ended_on}}, when your insurance changed.

statuses.meaning: Calendar-year enrollment has lapsed and the patient has not re-enrolled.
statuses.patient_text: Your copay program enrollment ended with the calendar year and needs to be renewed.

statuses.meaning: No bridge supply requested or needed.
statuses.patient_text: You're not receiving bridge supply.

statuses.meaning: Receiving bridge supply while coverage is delayed.
statuses.patient_text: You're receiving bridge supply from Tigerwater Specialty Pharmacy while your coverage is being decided.

statuses.meaning: Bridge ended because plan approved coverage.
statuses.patient_text: Your bridge supply ended because your plan approved coverage.

statuses.meaning: All 60 days dispensed.
statuses.patient_text: You've received the full 60 days of bridge supply, which is the most the program allows.

statuses.meaning: Bridge ended because all appeals were finally denied.
statuses.patient_text: Your bridge supply ended because your plan made a final decision not to cover QUORVANTA.

statuses.meaning: Not eligible (government insurance, uninsured, or bridge already used in the last 12 months).
statuses.patient_text: Bridge supply isn't available for your case. Your case manager can explain why and talk about other options.

statuses.meaning: No Foundation application.
statuses.patient_text: You haven't applied to the Arden Quay Patient Assistance Foundation.

statuses.meaning: Application received; documents missing.
statuses.patient_text: Your Foundation application has been received but isn't complete yet.

statuses.meaning: Complete application with the Foundation.
statuses.patient_text: Your complete application is with the Foundation, which decides within 5 business days of receiving everything.

statuses.meaning: Approved for 12 months.
statuses.patient_text: The Foundation approved your application. Your approval runs through {{pap.approved_through}}.

statuses.meaning: Interim Foundation supply while a Medicaid application is pending.
statuses.patient_text: The Foundation is providing QUORVANTA while your Medicaid application is being decided, for up to 90 days.

statuses.meaning: Did not meet published criteria.
statuses.patient_text: The Foundation wasn't able to approve your application. The letter it sent explains why, and your case manager can go through it with you.

statuses.meaning: 12-month approval lapsed without re-application.
statuses.patient_text: Your Foundation approval has ended. You can re-apply with updated income documents.

statuses.meaning: Pharmacy has scheduled the shipment with the patient.
statuses.patient_text: Your shipment is scheduled.

statuses.meaning: Left the pharmacy.
statuses.patient_text: Your shipment has left the pharmacy.

statuses.meaning: Carrier confirmed delivery.
statuses.patient_text: Your shipment was delivered.

statuses.meaning: Carrier or pharmacy delay reported.
statuses.patient_text: Your shipment is delayed. Your pharmacy has the latest details.

statuses.meaning: Pharmacy cannot ship until it reaches the patient to confirm delivery.
statuses.patient_text: Your pharmacy is ready to ship but needs to confirm the delivery details with you first. Please call them.
